mentions.name: Tab Wrangler
mentions.description: An open-source browser extension for Chrome and Firefox that auto-closes tabs after they have not been active for a configurable amount of time, similar to Mobile Safari's built-in feature but more configurable. It has been available for 10+ years and recently gained long-requested features.
mentions.source_excerpt: Continuing to work on Tab Wrangler, an extension for both Chrome and Firefox that has been available and open source for 10+ years. It auto-closes tabs when they have not been active for a configurable amount of time, similar to the feature built into Mobile Safari but more configurable.
